reviews.text: Went here with my parents and the owner was very friendly and kind honestly one of the best and coziest looking Dog grooming places I’ve ever been to my dog Lua turned out amazing and love her new style so much she’s so cute with her new style best place ever I highly recommend
Business cards littered all over the neighborhood - placing them on the fence at a dog park for them to fall on the ground is considered littering yes
Saw your cards at the dog park. Great Idea!! See you on our next visit.
Laura was exceptional
As always Ms. Laura and her team does exceptional professional courteous service we luv luv luv Laura  L💖ves D💖gs.

Overall, I have been pleased with the grooming service here. However, due to a demanding work schedule, I recently forgot to call and cancel an appointment. My dog was ill and I forgot to cancel the appointment. I was charged a 75% fee totaling $67.50, which I paid, but unfortunately, I will not be returning.The automated text system only allows clients to confirm, not cancel or reschedule. In a fast-paced environment where everyone is busy, returning a phone call just to cancel can easily be overlooked. Most modern confirmation services offer text-based cancellation or rescheduling, and updating this system would prevent clients from being penalized by rigid logistics.

My Sheepadoodle has been having some serious skin issues and recently started new medication, so I wanted to find a groomer who could give her a gentle, soothing bath. I reached out to Laura’s Loves Dogs, and I can’t say enough about how happy I’ve been with the entire experience!

Booking was incredibly easy. Laura answered on my first call and was able to get my dog in that same week. She came home not only looking absolutely adorable, but she already seems noticeably less itchy and much more comfortable.

We were so happy that we already booked our next appointment for five weeks from now! Looking forward to her next groom and would absolutely recommend Laura’s Loves Dogs, especially if you have a pup with sensitive skin.

We took our dog here for the first time today, but it surely won’t be the last! Fantastic team and a high quality result at very fair prices.

Shout out to Bee for doing an outstanding grooming job on our pup. Thank you!

This was our dog’s very first grooming experience in Philly after spending his whole life on the West Coast, so we were definitely a little nervous—especially because he can be anxious in grooming settings. We are so glad we found this place.

Charlie did such an amazing job with the grooming. Our pup came home looking adorable, and more importantly, calm and comfortable. You can tell Charlie is incredibly patient, skilled, and genuinely cares about the dogs.

Laura, the owner, was also so kind and patient with us during intake, which immediately made us feel welcomed and reassured as first-time clients.

We left feeling really happy (and relieved!) and are so glad our dog’s first Philly grooming experience was such a positive one. Highly recommend!

Literally the best groomer in the city! We bring our 2 dogs there at least 7 times a year to be groomed by Laura. Do yourself a favor and make an appointment with her for your pooch, you want be disappointed
Found this AMAZING groomer and I am hooked! Phenomenal job done with my 2 year old mini Poodle today.

This review is way overdue, but I’m so glad I found Laura Loves Dogs. I was referred by a neighbor whose dog looked amazing, and after seeing the results for myself, I completely understand why.

My dog was in terrible condition due to extensive matting, so I honestly had zero expectations going in because I assumed all of his hair would need to be shaved off. Somehow, the groomer worked a miracle. He did an incredible job, and my dog came out looking absolutely adorable.

What also stood out was the environment. It felt calm, welcoming, and like a great space for anxious dogs. Laura and her team were incredibly kind, patient, and professional throughout the entire experience.

So glad I finally found a groomer while I’m in Philadelphia. Highly recommend.

We have a beagle and a corgi and have had several issues finding a groomer who could deshed and trim our corgi correctly and handle our beagles nails who is extremely sensitive to them being trimmed.

We are happy to say that Laura Loves Dogs was excellent from start to finish. We've never been happier with a grooming job for both of our dogs than we have with them. We will definitely be taking our pups back and we can not recommend them strongly enough.

If you're looking for a truly great groom for your pup and a wonderful customer experience for you, take your pup(s) to Laura Loves Dogs!

Thank you for an excellent experience!

Louie and I were first timers ! From drop off to pickup up such a great experience! She listens to what cut you want for your baby and DELIVERS!!. She is a stylist ,She hand cut him.  Such a friendly environment. I can’t stop staring at my dog. More than usual. Already booked our next appointment 💕.
This is my second time here and I loved it. My dog Zola looked great after her grooming, and Sam gave my dog personal and careful attention. I’ll definitely be back!

Had a great experience getting my senior Pom groomed here! It’d been a couple of years as she has some health issues, but was in desperate need of deshedding. Samantha was amazing, she did a really wonderful job of setting me and Meatball at ease. I couldn’t believe she was able to get the stubborn hair knots behind her ears as well as her nails all trimmed up. Meatball got a glow up! And I’m a converted customer, really lovely shop and knowledgeable staff. Highly recommend!
Laura Loves Dogs is such an outstanding groomer. They take care of their clients as if they were their own pups - such care, thoughtfulness, and gentleness. Can’t recommend them enough!

I love this place! Laura and her crew are extremely professional and you can tell they love what they do. The ladies here have a great sense of humor. I’m so grateful they can handle my nutty dog, Leo❤️
Sam did a terrific job on my Teddy today- I highly recommend this groomer🌹
Ask for Samantha!!! 🐶💜 …
Samantha did a Great Job. Definitely Recommend

I took my newly adopted dog to Laura Loves dogs for the first time on March 19th.  I asked for a simple  bath no perfume and Sam did a good job.  She asked if he had any issues with bathing, but since I only had him a week, I honestly could not say.   She understood and said she would provide feedback on his behavior.  Sam clipped the nails and shaped his feet.  Everything went well according to Sam. Since my dog was shaved down at ACCT due to matting, a haircut was not needed.  So when he's ready for one we will be back to see Sam. Thanks to Sam for her care with my new furbaby.

My dog, Remy, can be a tough customer and the team at LLD’s was so gentle and caring with him. They are passionate about what they do and lead with compassion for their furry clientele. I highly recommend.
They were wonderful with my anxious girl! She hates getting her toes done and won’t let me touch em but they got her smelling all good and her nails are perfect. Will definitely be back!

Laura is the absolute best! I have a Siberian Husky, Balto, they are very tricky to groom and are very dramatic. Balto is excited to go and always comes back looking amazing! Even though he is stubborn, somehow they get him to look absolutely perfect.

I take my 3 dogs to Laura and they always come home looking and smelling amazing! I can't believe how she has mastered cutting Ash and Reggie's nails! It has been a nightmare trying to get some one who is capable of conquering this task !! Thank you thank you !!!

Cannoli loves visiting Laura! Although he’s 5, he’s still a newbie in the grooming world; a past experience elsewhere left him frightened and nervous. However, both times hes gone to Laura’s hes been very cheery; this time he knew where he was going and was all wags. Laura’s facility is very clean and we’ve both really liked the service.
Laura is VERY patient with our dog Jack and always does a great job grooming him! Happy she is in our neighborhood!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Laura Loves Dogs is paws-down the best groomer around. My scruffy mutt went in looking like a tumbleweed and came out ready for a dog show. The team is sweet, funny, and clearly adores what they do — and it shows. If you want your pup spoiled, pampered, and looking fabulous, this is the place. 🐾
She was excellent to work with very friendly and my dog Tank loved them!

I recently heard nothing but wonderful things about Laura Loves Dogs and couldn't resist sharing my excitement! Although I haven't had the chance to bring my furry friend there yet, the rave reviews from fellow pet owners have truly impressed me.

Many people have mentioned how Laura has an amazing talent for making pets look their best while ensuring they feel comfortable and loved during the grooming process. From stylish cuts to gentle handling, it seems she really knows how to cater to each pet's unique personality.

The attention to detail and the warm, welcoming atmosphere received high praise, along with Laura’s friendly demeanor. I love hearing that she offers a range of grooming services tailored to different breeds.

If you're looking for a trustworthy groomer who is passionate about pets, it sounds like Laura Loves Dogs is the place to go! I can't wait to book an appointment soon and experience the exceptional service everyone is talking about. Highly recommended based on the buzz I've heard! 🐾✨

I can’t say enough good things about Laura Loves Dogs! Laura has been grooming my very sweet but skittish Malshi since her very first haircut, and she’s been amazing from day one. My pup isn’t the easiest when it comes to sitting still, but Laura handles her with such patience, care, and genuine affection that it always puts both of us at ease.

You can really tell Laura loves what she does, she treats every dog like her own and takes the time to make sure they’re comfortable and happy. Somehow, she always manages to give my little wiggle worm the most beautiful, even cut every single time! My dog always comes home looking adorable, smelling wonderful, and most importantly, feeling relaxed and cared for.

If you’re looking for a groomer who’s not only skilled but truly has a heart for animals, Laura Loves Dogs is the place to go. Laura is a gem, and we’re so lucky to have found her! 🐾💖

Laura is not only a great groomer. She is very caring and empathetic. Her place is neat and clean. My dogs Hazel (Pomsky) and Aries (Husky) always look amazing and smell wonderful. They are always happy to see Laura which makes me feel comfortable leaving them in her care. Thank you, Lara! You are the best!
Very loving and professional service. I am so happy I have found Laura for my pup, knowing she's in good hands. Great clips and gentle and patient with her.
Laura is kind to pups and people. We have always had clean and professional work done with this groomer.
Beautiful groom
My little man who’s a bit energetic had the best cut of his life. Price was reasonable for the amount of work I know he is.so so so happy with the end result 10/10 will be back!

Terrible.I usually do my dogs grooming at home but I was very busy with work this month and was referred to Laura by a friend. The owner was outside smoking a cigarette and I walked up with my dog Benny. When I got to the front of the shop not only did she not acknowledge me she seemed visibly annoyed with me. My dog didn't want to approach her at all and seemed scared to be near her . She made some  weird remarks to me as some poorly groomed dog was leaving the shop. I wouldn't recommend her to anyone

I went in here to check out the place, I'm new to the neighborhood and  my dog crimson needed a bath. what I saw appalled me , someone who I think  was the owner Laura was yelling at her employee who seemed scared and i immediately walked out . I was told she was a good groomer but I can't support someone who's that unprofessional and inappropriate to their employees.
Laura did an excellent job grooming our dog! She did a very comprehensive grooming for the price! Would highly recommend
Laura always does a fantastic job with our Dachsund Dino! She is so great with him and he always leaves looking spiffy! Laura and her staff are so friendly and we love bringing Dino there.

We took our Siberian husky & lab mix to Laura earlier this summer.
We cannot express enough how wonderful of a job she did, how nice and clean the shop was, and how great the communication is.
Our husky (who sheds like a maniac) got a bath & deshed, and it lasted almost 6 weeks with minimal hair, which is UNHEARD of for a husky in the summertime.
I cannot recommend laura and her groomers enough. We can’t wait to come back!
Laura does an amazing doodle grooming! She is very patient with my baby, Simon, and he always get compliments on how great his haircut looks.. even a month later!

We moved to Philadelphia recently with our 10 year old dog and we were honestly stressed about finding a new groomer (she’d gone to the same one her whole life). Our smaller dog can be anxious and sometimes not too nice to other dogs. Laura and her team have done amazing grooming our dog. They know exactly how to cater to her attitude and her cuts are always amazing. We’re customers for life.
Laura not only does a great job grooming and treating Lola like a princess, she's a nice, down-to-earth person. It's a pleasure to do business with her - and Lola thinks shes swell!

Once again! Laura did an amazing job with our two dogs Preston and Violet! This is their 3rd visit, and Laura has gotten Violet our golden coat perfect from the last groomers not so good job! Thank you Laura, Preston our rescue always smiles after his groom!
My English bulldog loves seeing Laura!!! Laura is very professional and highly skilled. It’s super easy to schedule with her and she’s been a great addition to the Pennsport neighborhood.

Wish I could give more than 5 stars! Laura is amazing and is so caring with our very anxious one year old wheaten terrier. She takes so much extra care and attention to make Rosy feel at ease (plays calming music and has a scent diffuser!) rosy always looks amazing and is so happy! Thank you Laura we are so thankful we found you! 💖 …

We love Laura Loves Dogs! Every time we bring Bailey in, she comes out looking fantastic. Laura is friendly, professional, and clearly cares about all the dogs she grooms. Bailey always looks her best after a visit... clean, well-trimmed, and happy. We wouldn’t go anywhere else!
Laura did an amazing job on our Pomeranian Mika! This is the best haircut she has gotten in Philly, she looks absolutely gorgeous, Laura is the best groomer in the city! We are extremely happy!!!

We started taking our dog Bentley to Laura for his cuts as soon as her own shop opened. We could not be happier with the cut, care, patience and fair pricing.  The shop is clean, always smells good, has sounds of happy dogs and satisfied owners.
On Saturday 4/26/25 for the first time we scheduled Bentley's cut with the new groomer Jennifer, he needed a cut bad, and Laura's was booked solid.
Jennifer, like Laura, is patience, kind, attentive and did a great cut.

Highly recommend shop and both groomers.

Eileen Collins

First…the salon is immaculate,  set up is perfect to accommodate any pet.
Laura is an excellent groomer, her care with pets is above a 10. She makes the pet comfortable and is very in tune to their needs.
I have owned 3 standard poodles and my pups have had many cuts, Laura Loves Dogs is by far the best salon. Laura is a perfect choice to groom your pet. Cindy Pinto

This is the second time my adopted pup has been here and I swear he just looks better and better everytime some how!!! He was truly so happy when I came and picked him up, and was even enjoying some playtime with the staff. An extremely true difference from other places he’s been. He looks amazing and I couldn’t be any happier!!! Worth every penny! They even cater to his allergies which is so appreciated
Gracie has been groomed at least 5x by Loves Dogs and we couldn’t be happier! Laura always does a wonderful job and it is evident how much she cares for the pups she grooms!

Laura does a fantastic job with both of my dogs - Lola & Theo. They both become very reactive around nail grinders & nail clippers, but Laura is completely fearless and navigates the chaos my dogs can create with great precision. She does a fantastic job and I recommend her to everyone I know!

I’m surprise that my experience at Laura loves dogs was not what I expected considering the previous reviews. My dog’s haircut came out really uneven particularly under his belly. Also appeared to have small cut under his belly. Was told that he wasn’t shaved down and that was the way his hair grew, but he’s been to the groomer’s before and never had that issue.

Also when I booked the appointment, I booked with the owner Laura but it appears someone else cut his hair. When I received a quote on the cost to cut the cavapoo, was told 83-90 but I ended up paying $140 with tip.

I do not mind paying the price of 140 for grooming services but am disappointed that I paid that fee and did not get the stylist I booked with and a flawed haircut. Will take my dog back to previous groomer even though they’re a little further away.
Absolutely thrilled with Laura!  My larger sized Osito can be anxious and a wiggler.  Laura was patient and communicative.   Beyond thankful!
Laura is amazing with my girls.. she’s patient with the both of them.  She totally loves what she does, and I’m always satisfied and happy with her service

Was recommended Laura over and over again by locals in South Philly and she absolutely did not disappoint. Listened to all my preferences, was super gentle with my boy, and gave me some tips for home as well! Tito will definitely be back for his next groom :) thank you Laura!!!

Laura does a great job on our dog Cocoa. The service is consistently top notch. Cocoa is always clean and happy when she returns. She’s got a thick coat and needs consistent de-shedding, which Laura is excellent at. We’ll definitely be back and highly recommend.
OMG my pooch never looked so good! He was show worthy!  Laura is definitely 5 stars!
Laura is the best! She is so kind and does a fantastic job! Her added touches really shows she care. My furbaby is groomed to perfection every time!

This was my first time going to see Laura after being referred to see her and let me tell you, she did NOT disappoint!! My dog looks like a show dog! AND she offers different types of shampoos, my dog has dry skin so she recommended the oatmeal one and he looks and smells amazing! Champ cannot wait to go back! Thank you so much Laura!!
No question, best groomer we ever had.

Laura did a fantastic job with Daisy! I was so nervous at first since Daisy is 17 and blind, but thanks to Laura Loves Dogs I was able to stay and be there for Daisy and witness the excellent care Laura provides to the doggies!
Highly recommend Laura to take care of your pets. 5 stars!

Step right up! All you wonderful dog  owners. Laura loves dogs, which is the place to go when you want your beautiful pup to look like a winner in a competition. Laura knows exactly how to bring that sparkle out. Every dog deserves to be pampered. So, book your appointment now, and stop in to see how beautiful this dog world is, I promise you will be amazed.🐕🦮🐕‍🦺❤️🏆💯
Great customer service. Very kind and gentle with the animals. Did a great job on my Golden Shepherd which is not a small dog. I recommend their services.

Laura has been grooming my Beagle and my Daschund mix for years! I try doing it myself but it’s just not the same, she knows all the best tricks to do a great teeth cleaning and nail trimming, I can never get my dogs to sit still for that stuff. She really does have a talent, thanks Laura!

1st of all, Laura took my matted, old smelly dog, Cyrus at the last minute. 2nd, She DID SUCH an ABSOLUTELY WONDERFUL JOB, I'd give her 10 STARS if I could!! My 16 yr. old pup looks SO neat, Clean, young and healthy!!! I'm 100% Satisfied with Laura's Skills!! And being so close to my home helps, too!! Thank You, Again, Laura!! ♥️🥰🤗🐩🥰 …
Incredible job! My husband keeps saying this is our dog’s best groom. Great experience.

Just moved to pennsport and switched to Laura for grooming our long haired chihuahua. It’s the best cut he’s ever had! She listened to my preferences and was so sweet with my little guy. Super reasonable prices. We will be returning customers for sure!

Laura did an amazing job grooming our puppy! It was her first time getting any kind of professional wash/ grooming and she is very skittish but Laura was so patient and good with her. She did an amazing job on the haircut and even gave her a cute festive bandana! Cannot recommend her enough!

Brought 3 elderly dogs in as new clients. They were handled with care and understanding. All three were groomed very well. The prices are quite reasonable from what we were paying in New Jersey. Friendly and warm environment.

Laura took great care of our Pomsky Dash - She refused to cut his natural coat but we got a great trim and blowout which is totally worth it if you have a double coat dog. Laura is wonderful. We'll be back!

Laura is the best and she truly loves dogs!! She’s great at what she does. My dog hates getting her nails cut but Laura makes her feel at ease and does a thorough job. So excited she’s right around the corner too!
Laura takes such wonderful care of my Havanese Lola! I wouldn't trust my girl with anyone else!
We've had a great experience with Laura with our anxious dog! She goes above and beyond and is an expert groomer with so much valuable experience.

Great experience through and through. Laura worked with our dog who doesn’t love the groomer like a true professional. Her knowledge and expertise shone through during the entire appointment. We booked our next date immediately.
Laura has great with Zoey, my shihtzu. She always makes her look so pretty, and always smells so good.  Laura is the best!  Highly recommended!
Laura is great, she took amazing care of my two dogs and dedicated a lot of time to make sure they were comfortable. Her pricing is also super fair
